## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Return the user's saved note style, topics, and onboarding context from WriteStack (user metadata and linked publication analysis). Before drafting or generating new note bodies (e.g. for create_note or create_many_notes), call this tool first and align the output with these fields together with your other knowledge of the user.
